Subject: Integration scope + premium support question

Hi Ben / Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We27re excited about Redwood for inference but have a couple of asks before procurement will greenlight the purchase. Current purchasing window is tight (end of Q2). Two items: 

1) We need a one-off connector built to our internal event bus (Node-based webhook adapter). This is not in the standard onboarding SOW. Can Redwood deliver this as part of the onboarding package?

2) Our security/compliance team requires a Premium Support package included for the first 12 months (SLAs, on-call during rollout, 24/7 for critical incidents).

Procurement is also asking if there27s any flexibility on the list price for year one if we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity and a separate implementation fee. Ideally a concession on onboarding fees or a first-year credit to offset the connector work.

Attached: Silverline_Requirements.pdf (high level)

Appreciate a quick note on whether these items are standard or need executive signoff. We27re hoping to finalize by May 21.

Aisha — forwarding Caroline27s asks. Quick summary: 

- Connector: custom one-off connector to their event bus. Estimated 2-3 engineer-weeks for delivery and validation. Not in standard SOW.
- Premium Support: they want 12 months included (24/7 critical response + named SLA). We typically sell premium as an add-on; including it for free would be a material concession.
- Commercial ask: first-year concession to offset the connector (they suggested a credit against onboarding).

I27d like to request exec approval for: 
- Approve inclusion of the connector as a billable SOW line item but offer a one-time onboarding credit up to $25k (or X% of onboarding fee) to keep the list price visible.
- Approve including Premium Support for year one at a 50% discount (or waive the first 2 months).

Pros: closes the deal this quarter and gets them on reserved capacity. Risks: sets a concession precedent and increases delivery effort.

Can you advise next steps and whether Legal needs to be looped for SOW wording? Attaching our latest proposal and draft SOW for reference.

Attachments: Silverline_Proposal_v2.pdf, SOW_Silverline_Integration.docx

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Summary of proposed concessions from AE: 
- Offer a one-time onboarding credit up to $25,000 toward the connector work (connector billed separately in SOW).

Requested: Exec signoff or alternate guidance. If approved, I27ll ask Legal to add a clause to limit connector scope and a one-time credit line in the contract.

Aisha / Ben — after reviewing the revenue impact and delivery capacity I approve a limited concession to close this quarter under the following conditions: 

1) We will approve a one-time onboarding credit of $20,000 (not to exceed) applied against the onboarding invoice. The connector scope stays as a separately billable SOW line item with explicit acceptance criteria and a 3-week maximum engineering duration.

2) Premium Support: include year-one Premium Support at 40% off list price (applies only if they sign a 12-month reserved capacity contract at or above the proposed commit level). No retroactive credits.

3) Contract/Legal: add a scope-limiting clause in the SOW for the connector (max 3 iterations, defined webhook schemas, no custodial maintenance after go-live unless we convert to a support retainer). Also include a clause that allows Redwood to invoice separately for out-of-scope change requests.

4) Sales Ops: Ben/Aisha — update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-421) with the approved concession lines and submit to Legal for a quick SOW amendment. Please get procurement27s written confirmation to the reserved capacity commit by EOD May 18.

I27m not willing to waive Premium Support entirely, but the discount should be enough to get them across the line while protecting our delivery resources.

Once Legal confirms the SOW language, Ben please send the revised proposal + DocuSign stack to Caroline.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference
